intro: Complete CLI reference for the OpenAI Codex agent. Install with: npm install -g @openai/codex

sections.title: Basic Usage
sections.code:
codex "fix the TypeScript errors in src/api/users.ts"
codex --approval-mode auto-edit "add input validation to all API routes"
codex --quiet "run the test suite and show failing tests"

# Task from stdin
echo "add jsdoc to all exported functions" | codex
